body:
### What's new

- GPU indexing through ONNX Runtime: NVIDIA CUDA on Windows/Linux x64 and CoreML on macOS. Torch is not required.
- Independent indexing and search devices: build on GPU and search on CPU in the same index.
- Resume a partially completed 0.2.0 CPU index on GPU, preserving completed chunks and progress.
- GPU model sessions unload when indexing pauses or finishes.
- In-app updates download verified CPU/GPU packages, restart the application, and keep a rollback copy.
